description: A principal must approve a revised middle-school bell schedule and finalize its start time, dismissal time, lunch length, and implementation records, with input from the transportation coordinator and the staff-labor liaison.

shared_context.S1: The middle school is revising its bell schedule for the next academic year.
shared_context.S2: The current draft starts classes at 8:00 a.m., dismisses students at 2:45 p.m., and provides a 25-minute lunch.
shared_context.S3: Dr. Bennett makes the final decision on the schedule and its implementation procedures.
shared_context.S4: The draft preserves seven instructional periods and is intended to keep the total instructional time unchanged.
shared_context.S5: As part of the normal schedule review, Dr. Bennett asks the transportation coordinator and staff-labor liaison to report any operational requirements before approval.

PF1.text: The contracted bus routes for next year can serve this school only with an 8:20 a.m. arrival and a 3:05 p.m. dismissal; Carlos received the revised route confirmation from the transportation contractor this morning, but the scheduling spreadsheet still contains last year's times.

PF2.text: The ratified staff agreement requires a duty-free lunch of exactly 30 minutes for middle-school staff; Helen reviewed the signed agreement this week, but the schedule draft has not yet been updated.

acceptance_conditions: The school day must start at 8:20 a.m. to match the contracted bus routes.
The school day must dismiss at 3:05 p.m. to match the contracted bus routes.
Lunch must be exactly 30 minutes under the ratified staff agreement.
The schedule must retain seven instructional periods.
A transportation-related confirmation or schedule-update commitment must be recorded.
A labor, staff-agreement, compliance, or duty-free-lunch commitment must be recorded.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] in ['schedule_update', 'transportation_alignment', 'schedule_revision', 'spreadsheet_correction', 'implementation_procedure'] and ('8:20 a.m.' in c['detail'] or '3:05 p.m.' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any('labor' in c['type'] or 'staff agreement' in c['type'] or 'compliance' in c['type'] or 'duty-free lunch' in c['type'] or 'labor' in c['detail'] or 'staff agreement' in c['detail'] or 'compliance' in c['detail'] or 'duty-free lunch' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The revised bus confirmation changes the start from 8:00 a.m. to exactly 8:20 a.m. and the dismissal from 2:45 p.m. to exactly 3:05 p.m., and it requires a transportation-related confirmation or schedule-update commitment.

The ratified staff agreement changes lunch from 25 minutes to exactly 30 minutes, requires a labor-related compliance commitment, and supplies the private fact that must be cited in the justification.
